text:
lee.s: Spotted a staging Vault proxy debug endpoint that returns cached secrets when hit with the debug token. Found via a routine crawl. Endpoint: /debug/cache-state (auth by token). Potentially leaked service secrets to internal scanners.

hana: Which secrets are surfaced and scope? Can you dump example (redacted)?

lee.s: Minimal redacted snippet: 
```
{"backup_service":{"access_key":"AKIA***REDACTED***","secret":"***REDACTED***"},"db_migrator":{"token":"ghp_***REDACTED***"}}
```
It's returning several keys from `secret/staging/*`. Endpoint was added during a debugging session and not removed.

devops-bot: devops-bot: Created incident draft INC-8123 and flagged for rotation. Notifying infra oncall.

hana: Immediate actions: 1) disable debug endpoint (hotfix) 2) rotate any exposed creds 3) snapshot audit logs 4) scan for other debug endpoints. Who can patch the proxy?

lee.s: Patching now. I'll remove the handler and redeploy canary.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Running cluster scan for /debug endpoints and common debug tokens. Found similar endpoint in one other staging namespace pod (staging-worker-2). Quarantining network access via NetworkPolicy temporarily.

hana: Good. For rotation: if any AWS keys included, rotate at IAM and update Vault. If GitHub tokens, create new tokens and revoke old. Let's list owners. Backup service owner is @lee.s; DB migrator owner is @maria.g.

lee.s: Hotfix deployed, endpoint removed and pod restarted. Canary shows no debug route.

hana: I'll draft SEC ticket SEC-1519. Also adding CI secret-scan to fail builds that introduce debug endpoints in images (simple grep for '/debug' + server bind).

sec-bot: sec-bot: Running quick audit of Vault's unwrapping events at 2026-03-23T.. showed three unwrapping events tied to build-sa in that timeframe. We should correlate those sessions to the exposed secrets.

hana: If unwrapping events match the exposed keys, rewrap KMS transit key used by that Vault path and roll the secrets. Also enable stricter audit logging (include request metadata).

lee.s: I've rotated the AWS backup key and updated `secret/staging/backup-service` with new values. Deleted old key in IAM. Maria, please rotate DB migrator GH token.

maria.g: Rotated GH token and updated secret path. Confirmed no CI runs used the old token after rotation.

hana: RBAC follow-up: the proxy's service account had broad read privileges on namespace secrets. Plan: narrow to explicit allowed paths and deploy a validating webhook that rejects handlers exposing `/debug` in server init code.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Created webhook PR template and added a lint rule for `router.Handle("/debug"` in go code. Also added alert rule to detect new mounted debug tokens in config maps.

lee.s: Forensics: snapshot of exposed payload saved to secure bucket. No evidence keys were exfiltrated. NetworkPolicy blocked external access.

hana: Postmortem owners: hana (write), lee.s (remediation), maria.g (secret rotation). Include timeline, code PR, infra tickets. Recommend 30d rotation window for any secret exposed to an internal debug endpoint.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final cluster scan clear. Locking thread. :lock:

lee.s: Thanks all. Will add test coverage to ensure debug handlers are behind feature flags only.
